Derived resource-gap indicator: % of residents >15-minute walk from a cooling center
How to calculate / interpret: Population-weighted walking-distance analysis between residential areas and cooling centers.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Cooling center coverage per 10,000 residents
How to calculate / interpret: Number of cooling centers ÷ Community District population × 10,000.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Cooling-center access in high-HVI areas
How to calculate / interpret: % of high/very-high HVI population within 15 minutes of a cooling center.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Park access gap in high-HVI areas
How to calculate / interpret: % of residents in high-HVI areas living >10/15 minutes from a park.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Compound heat–air risk: overlap of high-HVI districts with elevated respiratory illness rates
How to calculate / interpret: Vulnerability Index + DOH Respiratory Illness Data

Derived resource-gap indicator: Heat vulnerability–resource mismatch score
How to calculate / interpret: Combine HVI, population density, land cover/impervious surface, and cooling-center access to identify high-vulnerability/low-resource areas.

Derived resource-gap indicator: % of flood-zone population
How to calculate / interpret: Population within FEMA/NYC stormwater flood area

Derived resource-gap indicator: % of flood-zone population without nearby evacuation resources
How to calculate / interpret: Population within FEMA/NYC stormwater flood areas that is >X minutes from an evacuation center.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Average distance from flood-exposed residents to evacuation centers
How to calculate / interpret: Population-weighted average distance to the nearest evacuation center.

Derived resource-gap indicator: % of population in stormwater flood areas with limited nearby public resources
How to calculate / interpret: Overlay flood maps with parks, libraries, nonprofits, SNAP centers, and other resources.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Critical-resource flood exposure
How to calculate / interpret: % of hospitals, trauma centers, libraries, nonprofit facilities, parks, etc. located within FEMA or NYC stormwater flood areas.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Sewage backup compounding risk: overlap of stormwater flood zones with proximity to wastewater treatment plants
How to calculate / interpret: NYC Stormwater Flood Maps + DEP Wastewater Treatment Centers

Derived resource-gap indicator: Average distance to hurricane evacuation center
How to calculate / interpret: Population-weighted distance from residential areas to the nearest evacuation center.

Derived resource-gap indicator: % of evacuation-zone residents >15/30 minutes from an evacuation center
How to calculate / interpret: Identify geographic access gaps within evacuation zones.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Evacuation center capacity per 10,000 evacuation-zone residents
How to calculate / interpret: Evacuation-center capacity ÷ evacuation-zone population.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Evacuation resource deficit
How to calculate / interpret: Evacuation-zone population relative to available evacuation-center capacity.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Evacuation-zone resource concentration
How to calculate / interpret: % of evacuation resources located inside/outside the zones they primarily serve.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Multilingual alert reach gap: LEP population within evacuation zones vs. Notify NYC language coverage
How to calculate / interpret: Hurricane Evacuation Zones + Community Health Profiles + Notify NYC RSS Feed

Derived resource-gap indicator: Vulnerable-population evacuation burden: trauma/surge capacity located inside vs. outside evacuation zones
How to calculate / interpret: Hurricane Evacuation Zones + Trauma Center Directory + Hospital Surge Capacity Sites

Derived resource-gap indicator: Respiratory illness burden per public-health resource
How to calculate / interpret: Respiratory illness rate/cases relative to nearby hospitals, trauma centers, or other health resources.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Hospital/trauma-center accessibility gap
How to calculate / interpret: Average distance/travel distance from residents to the nearest trauma center or hospital surge site.

Derived resource-gap indicator: High respiratory illness + low healthcare access areas
How to calculate / interpret: Identify CDs simultaneously above a respiratory illness threshold and below a healthcare-access threshold.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Hospital surge capacity per 10,000 residents
How to calculate / interpret: Surge beds/capacity relative to CD population.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Surge capacity relative to respiratory disease burden
How to calculate / interpret: Compare surge capacity with respiratory illness burden to identify potential demand-capacity mismatches.

Derived resource-gap indicator: % of residents with poor air-monitor coverage
How to calculate / interpret: Identify high-vulnerability populations that are far from NYCCAS monitors.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Average distance to nearest air-quality monitor
How to calculate / interpret: Population-weighted distance to the nearest NYCCAS monitor.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Population within X miles of solid-waste facilities
How to calculate / interpret: Overlay residential population with NYS DEC solid-waste facilities and report exposed population by CD.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Population within X miles of wastewater treatment facilities
How to calculate / interpret: Measure residential population near DEP wastewater treatment facilities, particularly in combination with flood risk.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Green space offset ratio: park/tree canopy acreage vs. environmental burden score
How to calculate / interpret: Land Cover Raster + Parks Properties + Environmental Burden Score

Derived resource-gap indicator: Hazardous-facility proximity + healthcare access gap
How to calculate / interpret: Population near solid-waste/wastewater facilities that is also far from hospitals/trauma centers.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Environmental hazard + flood-risk overlap
How to calculate / interpret: Population/land area where solid-waste or wastewater facilities overlap FEMA/NYC flood zones.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Environmental hazard exposure + air-monitoring gap
How to calculate / interpret: Population near environmental facilities that also lacks nearby NYCCAS monitoring.

Derived resource-gap indicator: Emergency communication resource gap
How to calculate / interpret: % of CD population in high-hazard areas with comparatively few libraries, nonprofits, cultural organizations, or other communication channels.
